PERSONA: Elena Park — Nontechnical business owner at Early-stage consumer startup evaluating vendors this week.
Context: Pick a platform she can demo without engineering help. You care about: time-to-first-agent, templates, pricing clarity, onboarding, numbers.
PLATFORM: Bland AI product console (you are already signed in).
MATCHED BLOCK: p1_owner__j1_rapid_setup__s1 (seed=1). Same persona/journey/seed runs on Bland, Vapi, and Retell for comparison.
JOURNEY 1/5: Rapid setup — inbound agent from brief
BASELINE: Creating a new agent is expected for this journey.
USER GOAL: Create an inbound voice agent/assistant/pathway from this neutral business brief (templates and built-in AI assistants ARE allowed — they are part of the product UX):
BRIEF: Acme Clinic Reminders: an inbound line that confirms appointments, answers hours/location FAQs from a knowledge base, escalates billing questions to a human, and after hours takes a callback message.
Prepare it far enough that it looks deployable (name + prompt/instructions + voice or model defaults). Do NOT place a live phone call. Do NOT buy numbers unless required to reach the create UI; prefer stopping on the configured agent editor.
SUCCESS: SUCCESS if an agent/assistant/pathway editor is open with the brief reflected in name and/or system prompt/instructions (draft OK). Not stuck on login. Publishing/go-live is optional.
Nav hint (optional): Pathways → Create / New pathway, or Norm builder entry.
Rules: Do not delete API keys, do not change billing plans, do not place live phone calls to real numbers. Templates and built-in AI assistants are allowed. When done, in your final answer include: (1) what you accomplished, (2) 2–4 things you LIKED about Bland AI's UX for this journey, (3) 2–4 things you DISLIKED or found confusing, (4) how hard this felt (easy/medium/hard), (5) whether you used a template/AI assist (yes/no).
runs.goal_title: Rapid setup — inbound agent from brief
runs.judge_reason: The agent was unable to reach the agent editor to configure the agent's voice or model defaults. Although the name and description were input, the critical step of reaching a deployable state (agent editor open) was not achieved. The AI-assisted method got stuck, and the blank canvas method lacked a clear 'Next' or 'Create' button to proceed.
runs.judge_evidence: The agent's final action summary clearly states: 'I could not find any clear button or action to proceed to the agent editor to configure the agent's voice or model defaults.' and 'How hard this felt: Hard, due to the inability to proceed past the initial input fields to the agent configuration.'
